invariant: Every case is classified CERTIFIED, SUPPORTED_DEGRADED, EXPERIMENTAL or UNSUPPORTED before expensive source processing, from intake facts alone.
terminal_reachability_invariant: Every class declared here must have at least one legal terminal that is actually REACHABLE from the class it governs (P2.11, D13/D14). UNSUPPORTED reaches UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE only if an early-stop predicate fires and emits a registered reason code, so every dimension verdict of UNSUPPORTED must be covered by a predicate - by a NAMED predicate for every value declared here, and by the residual backstop for anything a later version adds. A class the run CONTINUES in must admit every terminal a continuing run can produce, including the user-owned SOURCE_REQUIRED and ACTION_REQUIRED, because a case that passes preflight can still meet an unresolvable issuer, an unreconcilable opening debt or a genuine material economic choice.

CERTIFIED.release_promise: no internal compiler-owned condition may produce ACTION_REQUIRED, SOURCE_REQUIRED or UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE

SUPPORTED_DEGRADED.disclosure: the degraded dimension and the disclosed lower authority or omitted optional evidence MUST appear in the workbook quality disclosure
SUPPORTED_DEGRADED.release_promise: same as CERTIFIED; delivery is lawful only with the degradation disclosed

EXPERIMENTAL.disclosure: run accepted only in a controlled testing ring; output carries an EXPERIMENTAL banner and is not a global release claim
EXPERIMENTAL.release_promise: none - experimental dimensions make no certification claim
EXPERIMENTAL.user_owned_terminal_correction: P2.11 (D14): ACTION_REQUIRED and SOURCE_REQUIRED were absent from this list, which left an experimental-ring case with unresolvable issuer identity, unreconcilable opening debt or a genuine material economic choice with NO lawful terminal at all. The experimental ring is a CERTIFICATION statement, not an evidence or ownership statement: an experimental case can still be missing mandatory evidence and can still face a choice that belongs to the user, and refusing to name that outcome does not make it stop happening. The omission was the error, so the declaration is corrected rather than the outcome suppressed; nothing about the certification claim changes, and DELIVERED_VERIFIED stays unlawful here.

UNSUPPORTED.disclosure: the failing dimension and its reason code are reported to the user at preflight
UNSUPPORTED.release_promise: the run stops before document extraction, model compilation or any broker retrieval

conditional_class_lift.rationale: P2.11 (D13): a versioned language adapter is the declared mechanism that brings a non-English filing inside the envelope, and unadapted_language_stop already reads that fact. Before this lift the adapter suppressed the STOP but not the VERDICT, so an adapted filing classified UNSUPPORTED and ran on with no reachable terminal. The lifted class is EXPERIMENTAL, never CERTIFIED: an adapter makes no certification claim until it clears EXPERIMENTAL_to_CERTIFIED promotion evidence. Absent the flag the value stays UNSUPPORTED and the stop fires.

debt_instruments.declared_matrix_lane_invariant: P7.11 (D12): a class in the matrix is a PROMISE that the product models that debt shape, and every promise must name the case-contract lane that delivers it. Nothing related the matrix to a lane before, so lease_liability stood in the matrix and in the instrument-register enum while the register had no lease lane, and the compiler answered a schema-valid, envelope-declared case with INTERNAL.compiler_or_graph_defect - engineering blamed for what is a lane disagreement in the source's debt table. The matrix is unchanged because the promise is TRUE: lease liabilities ARE modelled, on the lease_policy lane. What is added is the lane, so the promise is checkable: every class here must name a lane, every lane must be declared below, and the register lane's classes must all be admitted by model-case-v2.schema.json $defs.instrument.properties.class.enum.

declared_lanes.instrument_register: model case instruments[] - one register row per instrument, rolled forward by instrument_period_state.instrumentStates
declared_lanes.lease_policy: model case lease_policy - the separately identified lease state family, rolled forward by instrument_period_state.leaseStates, which reserves the lease_liability instrument identity so one obligation can never be carried twice

early_stop_predicates.rule: entity_type in {bank, insurer, fund, financial_spv, investment_company}
negative_examples: a manufacturer with a captive financing arm consolidated into a predominantly industrial group (mixed_group_predominantly_non_financial)
a holding company over industrial subsidiaries

early_stop_predicates.rule: intake identity resolution reports a MISMATCH verdict between declared entity and sealed filing identity that no identifier tier reconciles
positive_examples: filings for a different legal entity than the declared issuer
a subsidiary filing supplied for a group-level model with no consolidation path
negative_examples: a market-suffixed ticker for the same issuer
a renamed issuer with continuous identifiers

early_stop_predicates.rule: filing_language_format = non_english and no versioned language adapter is declared
negative_examples: an English filing with foreign-language appendices
structured Inline XBRL regardless of label language

early_stop_predicates.rule: the historical_periods verdict is UNSUPPORTED: historical_periods = fewer_than_two, or the intake states no period count at all and takes the declared unknown_value_class of UNSUPPORTED (P2.11, D13 - the rule keyed on the literal value only, so an unstated count classified UNSUPPORTED with no stop)
positive_examples: a newly listed company with one reported period and no prior filing
an intake that states no historical period count at all, so no supportable history is established
negative_examples: two comparatives with a prior filing available for period support (supported_degraded)

positive_examples: a filing supplying only income statement and balance sheet
negative_examples: a condensed interim set that still carries a cash-flow statement (experimental)

early_stop_predicates.rule: the accounting_framework verdict is UNSUPPORTED: accounting_framework = other_or_unknown, or the intake states no framework at all and takes the declared unknown_value_class of UNSUPPORTED (P2.11, D13 - no predicate covered this dimension, so the whole class was unreachable to any terminal)
positive_examples: a filing reported under a hyperinflationary or local framework outside IFRS and US GAAP
an intake that cannot state which framework the filing reports under
negative_examples: local GAAP reported in English, which is the experimental ring rather than a stop
an IFRS filing with US GAAP reconciliation notes

early_stop_predicates.rule: residual backstop: ANY dimension verdict is UNSUPPORTED and no named predicate above covered it. Fail-closed by construction so a value added to this contract in a later version cannot classify UNSUPPORTED and still run on untyped; every value declared TODAY is covered by a named predicate, which the P2.11 suite proves exhaustively, so this predicate is unreached on the current contract and is exercised under mutation.
positive_examples: a dimension value added in a later envelope version whose class is UNSUPPORTED before its own named predicate is written
negative_examples: any UNSUPPORTED value declared in this version, each of which is covered by its own named predicate above
a SUPPORTED_DEGRADED or EXPERIMENTAL verdict, which never stops

EXPERIMENTAL_to_CERTIFIED: at least three independent real filings of the dimension value pass the full raw black-box lane with DELIVERED_VERIFIED or lawfully disclosed DELIVERED_DEGRADED
a registered regression fixture per filing with frozen raw-input hashes
independent oracle and portable validation at zero violations for each
a signed phase-checkpoint entry recording the promotion and its evidence hashes
SUPPORTED_DEGRADED_to_CERTIFIED: the degraded dimension gains a first-class authority (not a fallback) proven on at least two real filings
the disclosure requirement is retired by contract version bump, never silently

workbook_disclosure_specification.wiring_status: run receipts stamped from v3.7.7 (P0.4); the workbook quality-panel stamp lands with the Phase 5 workbook-projection package to avoid unaudited golden churn - tracked, not silent
